svg.title: 01. The stack
svg.desc: The stack: four layers, three seams. 04 AI: model and agent integration inside working systems, not demos. 03 Automation: pipelines, scripts and tooling that remove repeated work. 02 Interfaces: front ends and interaction behaviour that get used, measured and revised. 01 Infrastructure: services, deployment and the parts that have to stay up. Built with Python, Swift, TypeScript, Rust and CSS.
